hook: 怒 is a slave (奴) on top of a heart (心): a heart pushed down too long turns to anger.
All (全) members (員): every single person in the group.
Think (想) of an image (像): picturing something in your mind, imagination.
From 流れる (to flow): the flow of water, a stream or current.
What (何) + でも (even): whatever it is, anything at all.
Like 野原 (field): lie on your belly (腹, also はら) in the wide open plain.
袋 has cloth (衣) at the bottom: a bag sewn from cloth, like a shopping bag (レジ袋).
Water (氵) going (去) its fixed way: a rule everyone follows, a law or Act.
Heart (忄) + blue, young (青): fresh, pure feelings from the heart, emotion.
Without (ず) thinking (思う): you did it before you could think, unintentionally.
A person (者) who writes down (記) the news: a reporter.
Sentences (文) and phrases (句) thrown at you: a complaint.
Middle (中) study (学): the school in the middle, between primary and high school.
Middle (中) heart (心): the heart of something, its center or core.
Hand (手) + pass along (伝): lending a hand, help or a helper.
From 問う (to ask): a question. 問 is a mouth (口) at a gate (門), asking.
Same (同) + colleague (僚): someone at the same workplace as you, a co-worker.
Capital (都) + meet (会): where crowds of people meet, the big city.
Cities (市) grew around markets: いち is the old word for a market or fair.
Altar radical (礻) + say (申): the one you speak to at the altar, a god.
Metal (金) radical: the precious metal after gold, silver. Think 銀行 (bank).
Two earths (圭) inside go (行): roads lined with buildings, a town or street.
Situation (情) + report (報): a report on the situation, information.
職 has an ear (耳) on the left: a worker listening to orders at their job, as in 職業.
Blame (責) + entrust (任): a task entrusted to you that you are blamed for if it fails.
Mouth (口) + order (令): life itself. いのち: your life is in your blood (血, ち).
The one in front (前) of me: you. Casual, even rude, mostly used by men.
Hill (阝) + stop (艮): a hill you cannot get past, a limit.
Complete (完) + whole (全): totally whole, perfect.
From 迎える (to welcome): going out on the road (辶) to meet someone, a pickup.
Face (面) + contact (接): meeting face to face, an interview.
Manner, look (様) + 子: how things look, the state or appearance.
One (一) word (言): just one word, a short comment.
Hidden (秘) + tight (密): something kept tightly hidden, a secret.
Not (不) calm (安): not at peace, anxiety.
Calm (安) over wood (木), a desk: calm thinking at the desk makes a plan.
Words (言) + result (果): assigned work, like a lesson; an office section is the group given that work.
Half (半) + knife (刂): cut in half; paper sizes like A4判 come from cutting paper in halves.
Person (人) + life (生): a human life, from birth to death.
Period (期) + limit (限): the end of the time period, a deadline.
Time (期) + wait (待): waiting for a time you hope will come, expectation.
Lost (迷) + confused (惑): making people lost and confused, a bother.
辛 means bitter and spicy (からい): life that tastes bitter is つらい, painful.
Gain (得) + mind (意): you got what you wanted, so you feel proud. Also your strong point.
Strive (努) + power (力): putting all your strength in, great effort.
Relationship (仲) + between (間): people close to you, friends and fellows.
From 眺める (to gaze), with eye (目) radical: what you gaze at, a view.
Beat (拍) the hands (手): clapping, applause.
Between (間) + differ (違う): where things differ from the right answer, a mistake.
A wrapped (勹) mouthful (口) of words: a short phrase.
Bamboo (竹) radical: the joints on a bamboo stalk; a song's rising and falling joints make its tune.
Bamboo (竹) joints divide the stalk: so 節 is a section, a clause, or a season (季節).
身 is a picture of a body with a big belly: your body. み sounds like me, myself.
Self (自) + like that (然): things just as they are by themselves, nature.
Live (住) + people (民): the people who live here, residents.
Number (数) + character (字): characters for numbers, numerals.
Achieve (成) + merit (功): your hard work pays off, success.
From 泳ぐ (to swim): water (氵) + forever (永), staying long in the water, swimming.
Society, meeting (会) + member (員): a member of a club.
Price (価) + value (値): what something is worth.
Air (気) + warm (温): how warm the air is, air temperature.
Teach (教) + subject (科) + book (書): the book that teaches a subject, a textbook.
No (無) fee (料): free of charge.
辞 means resign (辞職): you hand in your resignation and quit your job.
Excellent (優) + win (勝): the best win of all, the championship.
Carry in hand (携) + belt (帯): something you carry on you, a mobile phone.
Fat, big (太) + sunshine (陽): the big source of sunshine, the sun.
Inside (内) + contain (容): what is contained inside, the contents.
Mother (母) + parent (親): the mother parent.
Change (変) + turn into (化): something changes into something else.
Beforehand (予) + think (想): thinking about it before it happens, a prediction.
Water (氵) + wine jar (酉): liquid from a wine jar, alcohol.
並 shows people standing side by side in a row: ordinary, like the normal size at a beef bowl shop.
Seen in 能力 (ability) and 可能 (possible): 能 is being able, being skilled.
Extra, useless (冗) + talk (談): extra talk that is not serious, a joke.
Trust (信) + sign (号): a sign you trust to tell you when to go, traffic lights.
Both kanji have a roof (宀): the great roof over everything, the universe.
Untie (解) + decide (決): untie the knot and decide, a solution.
Lively (活) + move (動): moving actively, activity.
Ring, surround (環) + border (境): what surrounds you, your environment.
Together (協) + power (力): putting power together, cooperation.
From 切る (to cut): a piece that was cut off, like a scrap of cloth.
Things (物) + tell (語): telling about things, a tale or story.
Hold out (提) + plan (案): holding out a plan to others, a proposal.
Send out (発) + surface, show (表): putting it out for everyone to see, an announcement.
Report (報) + tell (告): telling what happened, a report.
Lost (迷) + child (子): a lost child. Note the special reading まいご.
Truly (真) red (赤): completely red, like a face bright red with anger.
Hill (阝) + festival (祭): where things meet, an edge; so the moment when, on the occasion of.
Next (次) + woman (女): a woman's shape, figure or appearance.
Step (彳) + weapon (殳): soldiers each with a duty, a role or position.
Water (氵) + 尼: wet earth, mud. どろ sounds like dirt row.
Praise, agree (賛) + become (成): you come to agree, approval.
幸 means happiness and luck, also read こう in 幸福 (happiness).
Correct (正) + straight (直): straight and correct, honest.
Trust (信) + rely (頼): trusting and relying on someone.
Correct (正) + certain (確): surely correct, accurate.
Stay (居) + room (間): the room where you stay, the living room. Not 今 (いま, now).
Run, manage (営) + business (業): running a business, sales and trade.
From 勝つ (to win): a win. Do not mix up with 価値 (かち, value).
関 means connection, as in 関係: to be connected with, about (に関する).
Record (記) + remember (憶): what is recorded in your mind, memory.
From 決まる (to be decided): what has been decided, a rule.
From 下る (to go down): going down, the train heading away from Tokyo.
Present, appear (現) + place (場): the actual place where it happens, the scene.
Now (今) + time (回): this time.
Roof (宀) + hand (寸): a hand guarding the house, to protect.
Writing (文) + character (字): written characters, letters.
Same as もじ: writing (文, もん) + character (字); もんじ is an older, rarer reading.
From 喜ぶ (to be glad): 喜 is a drum over a mouth (口), drumming and singing for joy.
Straight (直) + contact (接): straight contact, direct.
Pass through (通) + translate (訳): passing words through to another language, interpreting.
Capital (都) + city (市): a city, an urban area.
Wide (博) + scholar (士): a person of wide learning, a doctor (PhD). Special reading はかせ.
Suffer (被) + harm (害): harm you suffered, damage.
Way (方) + method, law (法): the way to do it, a method.
Thread (糸) radical: threads tied together into a group, a class or team.
極 means extreme, the pole (北極): ごく, to the extreme, very.
豆 looks like a bowl on a stand, full of beans: beans, peas.
Tree (木) + every (毎): the plum tree, blooming every early spring.
Person (亻) + connect (系): the person connected to the job, the one in charge.
That (其) + earth (土): the ground under it, the base or basis.
Gather (集) into the middle (中): gathering your mind to one point, concentration.
One (一) blink (瞬): in one blink, an instant.
Perform (演) + play music (奏): playing music, a performance.
Feel (感) + sense, wake (覚): what you feel and notice, a sensation.
Feel (感) + thank (謝): feeling thankful, gratitude.
Feel (感) + move (動): your feelings get moved, being deeply touched.
Plan, undertake (企) + business (業): an undertaken business, a company.
Forbid (禁) + stop (止): forbid and stop, a ban.
Examine (検) + look into (討): examining and discussing carefully, consideration.
Run (走) radical: run over the top, to go over or cross.
Reason, logic (理) + untie (解): untying the logic, understanding.
Retreat (退) + bend (屈): leaning back, slumped and bored, tedium.
State, manner (態) + degree (度): the way you behave, your attitude.
常 means usual, as in 日常 (daily life): つねに, always.
Wisdom (哲) + study (学): the study of wisdom, philosophy.
From 残る (to remain): what is left over.
Not (不) enough (足): 足 means foot and also enough; not enough, a shortage.
牛 looks like a cow's head with horns: cattle. うし: ooh, she is a cow.
害 means harm: found in 被害 (damage) and 公害 (pollution).
Tree (木) + public (公): the pine. まつ: the pine waits (待つ) all year, always green.
直 means direct: じかに, directly, with nothing in between, like 直接.
Real (実) + occasion (際): what really happens, in reality.
Branch off (支) + hand out (配): handing out orders to others, control or rule.
Food (食) + goods (品): food products.
Cut off (絶) + opposite (対): nothing opposite can exist, absolutely.
明 is sun (日) + moon (月), bright: 明かり is a light.
White (白) + water (水): clear white water bubbling up, a spring.
Big (大) + house (家): the one who owns the house, the landlord. Special reading おおや.
Study (学) + person (者): a person who studies, a scholar.
Song (歌) + hand (手), a skilled person as in 選手: a person who sings, a singer.
Wide (広) + tell (告): telling everyone widely, an advertisement.
Country (国) + language (語): the national language; in Japan, Japanese class.
From 好む (to like): what you like, your taste.
差 means difference, as in 時差 (time difference).
Material, timber (材) + ingredients (料): what you make things from.
Eye (目) + target (的): the target your eye is on, your purpose.
Pledge, bond (契) + chance (機): the moment things connect, an opportunity.
Chosen (選) + hand (手), a person: the person chosen for the team, a player.
Ground (地) + ball (球): the ball of ground we live on, the earth.
Store (貯) + money (金): stored money, savings.
Go through (通) + work (勤): going to work and back, commuting.
Choose (選) + raise (挙): raising hands to choose, an election.
Challenge (挑) + battle (戦): challenging someone to battle.
皮 shows a hand (又) peeling off skin: skin, hide, leather.
Bamboo (竹) radical: a bamboo stalk is hollow, a pipe or tube.
Bamboo (竹) radical, hollow like bamboo: a tube. かん is also in 管理 (management).
Person (亻) + middle (中): what is in the middle between people, a relationship.
Person (亻) + elephant, image (象): an image of a person, a statue.
Self (自) + body (身): your own self.
Real (実) + test (験): testing it for real, an experiment.
Pay out (支) + pay (払う): payment.
Blink (瞬) + interval (間): as long as a blink, a moment.
Tax (税) + money (金): tax money.
Become (成) + grow (長): growing up, growth.
Politics (政) + government office (府): the government.
From 集まる (to gather): a gathering. 集 is birds (隹) on a tree (木).
新 means new: 新た is new, fresh.
Mind (意) + know (識): your mind knowing what is going on, consciousness.
Medicine (医) + heal (療): medical treatment.
Pass (過) + gone (去): time that passed and went, the past.
Complete (完) + make (成): made completely, finished.
Pledge (契) + promise (約): a promise you pledge, a contract.
Say (言) + language (語): language. Here 言 is read げん.
Present (現) + age (代): the present age, modern times.
Craft (工) + place (場): a workplace; こうば is a small workshop, こうじょう a bigger factory.
Old, former (故) + village (郷): your old village, your hometown.
Make (作) + goods (品): something made, a work of art.
Full (満) + enough (足): full and with enough, satisfied.
Beforehand (予) + calculate (算): calculating money beforehand, a budget.
止 means stop: よす, to stop doing something, give up (like やめる).
Toil (労) + work (働): hard physical work, labor.
From 別れる (to part): farewell. 別 has a knife (刂): cut apart.
From 驚く (to be surprised): 驚 has a horse (馬), a horse jumping in surprise.
All (全) + body (体): the whole body of something, the whole.
Husband (夫) + wife (婦): husband and wife, a married couple.
皿 looks like a dish seen from the side: a plate. さら: salad on a plate.
率 means rate, as in 確率 (probability): りつ, the ratio.
Water (氵) + return (戻): water coming back out of your eyes, tears.
